mn138:23.15: tesanno āyasmatā mahākaccānena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi byañjanehi attho vibhattoti.
mn138:24.1: paṇḍito bhikkhave mahākaccāno mahāpañño bhikkhave mahākaccāno
mn138:24.2: mañcepi tumhe bhikkhave etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha ahampi evamevaṃ byākareyyaṃ yathātaṃ mahākaccānena byākataṃ
mn138:24.3: eso ceva tassa attho evañca naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
mn138:24.5: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
